Name: Ana Reed, 34, Female, body type Thin.
Childhood: Farm kid. Grew up hauling water and mending fences on a dry-land farm.
Adulthood: Cook. Ran a canteen for miners and learned to read a room by what people ordered.
Traits: Kind (Genuinely cares about others and is slow to anger.); Optimist (Expects things to turn out fine, mostly.)

diary.text: The snow started coming down today. We marked the places and made things steady before the sun went dark. There was a body in the yard where it happened, and Old Odo passed away.
The naming of the east hill as Widow's Rest felt like a necessary structure. Raiders came through the day, but the raid is now finished. There was a wedding, and then the warm fire felt right.
